notes.text: Pages show a skeleton shaped like the page while they load, instead of a generic bar.
The account menu holds its place in the sidebar while your account loads.
Pull down on Needs you, Goals, Projects or Verdicts to reload the page on your phone.
Needs you shows how many goals are waiting on you, on the tab and in the sidebar.
The phone layout got a pass at 390px: spacing, tap targets and page headers are tidier.
What's new is in your account menu and on the More tab, with a dot until you have read it.
